# Vault

> Vault is a mobile-first personal finance app for individuals in Brazil and Portugal. It helps users track transactions, manage cards, set goals, and automate recurring bills with a premium dark UI.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Marketing landing page for the Vault personal finance app.
- [Get started](/pre-onboarding): Introduction and PWA install prompt for new users.
- [Sign in or sign up](/auth): Account creation and login screen.
- [Plans and pricing](/plans): Trial, monthly and yearly subscription plans.

## Optional

- [Help and support](/support): Support ticket form for signed-in users.
